title: form_pages re-implements the pub brand header instead of reusing application/form_view.view_brand_header
detail: Byte-identical private copy of the pub helper the file already imports (form_view is used for view_footer). The wordmark now exists in three places with a documented keep-in-sync warning; a markup change drifts the referee shell.
recommended_fix: In page_shell, call form_view.view_brand_header() and delete the private fn view_brand_header from form_pages.gleam.

title: form_copy exports save_label and other_option_label that no production code renders
evidence:
form_copy.gleam:94: pub const save_label = "Save"
form_copy.gleam:342: pub const other_option_label = "Other"

Only references in the repo (server/src, client/, shared/, server/priv/static):
server/test/reference_checks/form_copy_test.gleam:55:     form_copy.save_label,
server/test/reference_checks/form_copy_test.gleam:148:     form_copy.other_option_label,

The rendered per-question forms use continue_label/opt_yes; the JS only ever shows server/priv/static/reference_form.js:27: var SAVED_TEXT = "Saved"; The live "Other" option is form_copy.opt_other, used by the question registry.
detail: save_label ("Save") never renders anywhere — per-question forms submit Continue/Yes and the JS marks "Saved" — and other_option_label duplicates opt_other. Only the exhaustive em-dash copy test touches them, so they are dead exports.
recommended_fix: Delete both constants and drop their entries from form_copy_test.gleam's all_strings(); the registry already uses opt_other for the Other option.
